name: reqif.analyze
title: Analyse ReqIF file
summary: Preview the import of a ReqIF file: types, attributes and values without mapping; for a repeated delivery the new, changed and dropped requirements and the conflicts with local changes; the losses. Writes nothing.

source.description: Source name for a file of ReqSeq without mapping; default the header TITLE.

new.description: Objects the import would create as new elements, without UUID.

changed.description: Elements of an earlier delivery of the source (same source IDENTIFIER) whose version with the delivery differs from their import version, conflicts included (SR-056 AK1).

dropped.description: Elements of the source whose object the file no longer has; the import only lists them (SR-056 AK3).

conflicts.description: Changed elements that were also changed locally since their import; reqif.import needs take or keep for each (SR-056 AK4).

problems.description: Warnings: a title, property or relation the import writes over another value (reqif.replaces-local), a repository not on this machine, an element file that cannot be read.
